sourceText.he: מַעֲשֵׂר רִאשׁוֹן כּוּ׳: פְּשִׁיטָא! לָא צְרִיכָא כְּגוֹן שֶׁהִקְדִּימוֹ בִּכְרִי. מַהוּ דְתֵימָא כְּדַאֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב פָּפָּא לְאַבָּיֵי — קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן כִּדְשַׁנִּי לֵיהּ.

positions.claim: one who ate first tithe whose teruma was not separated is not included in a zimmun
the clause is needed for first tithe the Levite took ahead of the priest in the pile, teaching that it still requires teruma gedola
positions.basis: לא צריכא; Abaye's answer to Rav Pappa

positions.claim: first tithe taken ahead of the priest in the pile should likewise be exempt from teruma gedola
first tithe taken from the pile differs from first tithe taken on the stalks and is not exempt
